No moon tonight: Cella leaves the porch light on

Jan 7, new moon at 20:24 UTC: tonight the moon is 0.1% lit and the sky is dark. Cella turns on the porch light and leaves the door unlatched.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A night patio under a dark blue sky full of stars and no moon. A small amber block figure with white eyes stands on the left and a door stands on the right. A square patch of warm light switches on next to the door and the figure's eyes go wide. It walks toward the door and leans in, and the door opens a crack with a thin line of warm light. The figure's eyes close in a smile and it pulses. The text stays: jan 7, no moon tonight, the porch light stays on. The last card: for whoever is coming home after dark, Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: Cella left the light on tonight. Somebody is coming home to it.
evolucion: Dos apuestas (junta-dic-s4, seccion 3). (a) El cierre con persona, sin pedido: ninguna pieza pide guardar, comentar, compartir, enviar ni seguir (regla 8); el fijado es una frase de Cella que nombra al destinatario. Base de lectura: N2 16 % (14 de 88 Reels), 1,5 envios por 1.000 de alcance, mediana de alcance 117; con el mismo corte de la hora 168 (3-ene). (b) El destinatario como gancho: brazo A (abre con "For whoever ..." en el cuadro 0 y vuelve a cerrar) contra brazo B (solo cierra). Se mide a 48 h con medir.py (envios por 1.000 de alcance, vistas comprometidas) y a 7 dias con objetivos.py (N2, N4). Con 14 seguidores y la semana de fiestas no separa causa de temporada: lectura de orden de magnitud.
